per_runner_limit.startup_error: Failed to start workflow action "BuildBuddy Linux CPU sweep 32": Runner requests 32 vCPUs, exceeding your organization's per-runner CPU limit of 16 vCPUs. Reduce the runner size or contact support@buildbuddy.io to discuss your workload and request a higher limit.
per_runner_limit.note: Organization-specific runner ceiling; distinct from advertised remote-execution core allowance. Failed before allocation.

selection.criterion: Smallest tested size within 10% of fastest median source-invalidation build/test time.

limitations: Two samples per CPU count, on one AMD EPYC VM; not a stable tail estimate.
All samples share a warmed Bazel JVM and native dependencies; not cross-workflow startup/queue timings.
Comment-only Rust invalidation, cached UI tests; no representative PR distribution, cold/RBE scaling, Docker or full-PR benchmark.
RocksDB native build-script worker limit stays four; RAM reservation stays 16 GB, action budget 12 GiB, JVM heap 4 GiB.
CPU affinity restricts workload and retained workers; VM exposed 19 CPUs, but no sample used more than 16.

report.method: One excluded seed; unique comment-only Rust input per sample; ascending then descending CPU order. Same VM, 16 GB reservation, 4 GiB JVM, 12 GiB action-memory budget, local execution, remote uploads disabled.
